task.name: stack_pepsi_can_cup
task.description: Use the left arm to pick up the blue pepsi can and place it into the green cup.

substages.substage: 1. Move the left arm to approach and align with the blue pepsi can.
2. Grasp the blue pepsi can with the left arm.
3. Move the left arm to align with the blue cup.
4. Release the gripper to place the blue pepsi can into the blue cup.
